info.name: Advanced Melee Weapons
info.description: Advanced Melee Weapons from the Grim Hollow: Player's Guide (2025).
info.author: Ghostfire Gaming

element.name: Catchpole
element.supports: ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_CATEGORY_MARTIAL_MELEE, ID_INTERNAL_DAMAGE_TYPE_PIERCING, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_HAFTED, ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_PROPERTY_REACH, ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_PROPERTY_TWOHANDED, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_ENTANGLING

div.p: Entangling. When you take the Attack action on your turn and hit with an Entangling weapon, you can use a Bonus Action later on the same turn to entangle the target. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 10 plus your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Grappled condition until it escapes or until you release the weapon. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger.

element.name: Cavalry Flail
element.supports: ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_CATEGORY_MARTIAL_MELEE, ID_INTERNAL_DAMAGE_TYPE_BLUDGEONING, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_MOMENTUM, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_SWIFT

div.p: Swift. When you miss with a Swift weapon, you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with the weapon against the same target before the end of your next turn. If that attack hits, it also deals an extra 1d4 damage of the weapon’s normal damage type.

element.name: Cavalry Hammer
element.supports: ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_CATEGORY_MARTIAL_MELEE, ID_INTERNAL_DAMAGE_TYPE_BLUDGEONING, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_ARMOR_PIERCING, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_MOMENTUM, ID_WOTC_PHB24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_SLOW

div.p: Slow. If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

element.name: Cavalry Pick
element.supports: ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_CATEGORY_MARTIAL_MELEE, ID_INTERNAL_DAMAGE_TYPE_PIERCING, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_ARMOR_PIERCING, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_MOMENTUM, ID_WOTC_PHB24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_SAP

div.p: Sap. If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

element.name: Chakram
element.supports: ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_CATEGORY_MARTIAL_MELEE, ID_INTERNAL_DAMAGE_TYPE_SLASHING, ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_PROPERTY_FINESSE, ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_PROPERTY_LIGHT, ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_PROPERTY_THROWN, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_RETURNING

div.p: Returning. When you make a ranged attack with a Returning weapon, the weapon returns to you immediately after hitting or missing the target. You can catch the weapon if you have a hand free to do so.

element.name: Claymore
element.supports: ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_CATEGORY_MARTIAL_MELEE, ID_INTERNAL_DAMAGE_TYPE_SLASHING, ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_PROPERTY_HEAVY, ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_PROPERTY_TWOHANDED, ID_GFG_GHPG25_WEAPON_PROPERTY_BRUTAL

div.p: Brutal. Brutal weapons score Critical Hits on a natural roll of 19 or 20. If your Critical Range is already increased, instead increase it by 1 point (such as from 19-20 to 18-20). When you score a Critical Hit with a Brutal weapon against a creature, the weapon deals one additional die of damage.

div.p: Disarming. When you take the Attack action on your turn and hit with a Disarming weapon, you can use your Bonus Action later on the same turn to disarm the target. Both you and the attacker must make opposed attack rolls, ignoring any sources of Advantage and Disadvantage. If your result is higher and the weapon is something the target can drop, the weapon falls from the target’s grasp, landing in its space.

div.p: Slow. If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.
